defects.title: Language parameter passed un-resolved to SQLite INSERT
defects.rootCause: Line 440 was passing raw 'language' argument instead of 'resolvedLanguage' ('te-en') to parameterized SQL query, leading to language mismatch in database records.

defects.title: SubmitFeedbackModal stores prop unused in store selector
defects.rootCause: The modal received 'stores' as a prop but rendered hardcoded static options instead of iterating over provided stores dynamically.

defects.title: Unused imports and React Hook missing dependencies
defects.rootCause: Unused Lucide icons (MessageSquare, Filter, Clock) and state variables left in view components; useEffect in TrendsView missing dependency trigger.

defects.title: Missing executable permissions and Rollup native bindings on macOS arm64
defects.rootCause: node_modules/.bin binary shims lacked executable permission bits and @rollup/rollup-darwin-arm64 required optional dependency resolution.
defects.regressionTest: chmod +x frontend/node_modules/.bin/* && npm run build --prefix frontend

defects.title: Telugu-English HVAC phrasing incomplete matching
defects.rootCause: Phrasing 'a/c assalu work avvatledu' and 'on cheyaledu' required optional adverb regex patterns in EQUIPMENT_FAILURE rule definition.

securityAudit.sqlInjectionRisk: NONE (100% Parameterized queries via better-sqlite3 / pg Pool)
securityAudit.xssProtection: VERIFIED (React JSX automatic escaping + server-side type validation)
securityAudit.secretLeakage: NONE (Inspected .env keys; secrets zeroed in test logs)
securityAudit.pathTraversal: NONE (Uploads constrained to data/uploads directory with sanitizeFilename)
